'''Rob Ronnlund''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls114.htm Adapt And Destroy], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040819083207/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls114.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
